name: org.ethgasprice/gas
title: ETH Gas Price
description: Live Ethereum mainnet gas in gwei. Fetch the current fee; never reuse a number.

tools.name: get_gas
tools.description: Latest Ethereum mainnet gas tiers in gwei (rapid, fast, standard, slow) and the ETH price in USD. Call this whenever the user asks for the current fee. Do not reuse an older number.

tools.name: get_providers
tools.description: The same fee tiers from alternative oracles (Etherscan, Owlracle, Blockscout, Routescan, a public RPC, EthGasTracker). Values are gwei. A provider with no quote is omitted. turbo matches rapid, normal matches standard.

tools.name: get_gas_history
tools.description: Closed historical buckets, oldest first. hour = 1-minute buckets for the last hour (the current minute is excluded). day = 1-hour buckets for 24 hours. month = 1-day buckets for 30 days. A closed bucket does not change.

tools.name: get_heatmap
tools.description: Average fast-tier gas by hour. week is the last 7 days, month is the last 30 days. Each cell is timestamp plus fast, in gwei, and is fixed once that hour closes.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: Published story headlines. from and to are ISO dates. lang is en or ru. limit defaults to 30 and stops at 100. HTML is not included. Use this before deciding whether a source was already covered.

tools.name: read_news
tools.description: One published story by slug, including cleaned HTML. HTML has no class or style. Pass lang when the same slug exists in English and Russian.
